html:
Kotor is a walled port town at the inner end of the Bay of Kotor in Montenegro, under Venetian rule from 1420 to 1797.

It was a Roman and Byzantine town and then a self ruling port of medieval Serbia, home to sailors and merchants. Its Cathedral of Saint Tryphon dates from 1166. Under Venice its walls were extended up the mountain behind the town. Kotor's captains served Venice in its wars with the Ottomans, and the bay became a nest of shipowners. After Napoleon and a century of Austrian rule, Kotor joined Yugoslavia in 1918 and became part of Montenegro in 1945. Hit by the 1979 earthquake, the restored old town is a World Heritage Site.
sum: Kotor is a walled port town at the inner end of the Bay of Kotor in Montenegro, under Venetian rule from 1420 to 1797.
